title: Bayesian statistical inverse problems for a coupled Fokker-Planck-Darcy system
summary: We study the nonparametric statistical inverse problem of recovering the space-dependent permittivity in a coupled Fokker-Planck-Darcy system from discrete, noisy observations of the Fokker-Planck solution. We consider the coupled parabolic-elliptic system on a bounded domain with the physically natural no-flux boundary condition for the Fokker-Planck equation and homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions for the Darcy equation.
